## Attachment: text of each amendment adopted

**Amendment 1: Members.** The statement of the Articles of Incorporation "There are voting members for the nonprofit corporation." is deleted and replaced by: "The Corporation shall not have voting members as that term is used in the Colorado Revised Nonprofit Corporation Act and shall have no capital stock."

> Carries its authorities verbatim; substitutions: aoa-act×1. Authority: Articles of Incorporation, Colorado Secretary of State document 20251193974; Bylaws Article 3; C.R.S. 7-122-102; C.R.S. 7-130-101.

**Amendment 2: Purposes.** The following provision is added: "The Corporation is organized exclusively for charitable, scientific, and educational purposes, including, for such purposes, the making of distributions to organizations that qualify as exempt organizations under section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code, or the corresponding section of any future federal tax code."

> Carries its authorities verbatim; substitutions: aoa-said×1, aoa-purposes×1. Authority: IRS Publication 557 (Rev. January 2025), Appendix, Sample Articles of Organization, Draft A, Third (purpose clause); 26 CFR 1.501(c)(3)-1(b)(1)(i); Instructions for Form 1023 (Rev. December 2024), Part III line 1, Purpose clause; 26 U.S.C. 501(c)(3); Bylaws 1.2; C.R.S. 7-122-102.

**Amendment 3: Primary purpose.** The following provision is added: "Within those purposes, the primary purpose of the Corporation shall be to develop a universal data standard for the semantic web, open science, and frontier technologies."

> Carries its authorities verbatim. Authority: Bylaws 1.2; Bylaws Article 12; C.R.S. 7-122-102.

**Amendment 4: Limitations.** The following provision is added: "No part of the net earnings of the Corporation shall inure to the benefit of, or be distributable to its members, directors, officers, or other private persons, except that the Corporation shall be authorized and empowered to pay reasonable compensation for services rendered and to make payments and distributions in furtherance of the purposes stated in Amendment 2. No substantial part of the activities of the Corporation shall be the carrying on of propaganda, or otherwise attempting to influence legislation, and the Corporation shall not participate in, or intervene in (including the publishing or distribution of statements) any political campaign on behalf of or in opposition to any candidate for public office. Notwithstanding any other provision of these articles, the Corporation shall not carry on any other activities not permitted to be carried on (a) by a corporation exempt from federal income tax under section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code, or the corresponding section of any future federal tax code, or (b) by a corporation, contributions to which are deductible under section 170(c)(2) of the Internal Revenue Code, or the corresponding section of any future federal tax code."

> Carries its authorities verbatim; substitutions: aoa-trustees×1, aoa-article-third×1, aoa-corporation×5. Authority: IRS Publication 557 (Rev. January 2025), Appendix, Sample Articles of Organization, Draft A, Fifth (limitations); 26 CFR 1.501(c)(3)-1(b)(1)(i); 26 U.S.C. 501(c)(3).

**Retained: Dissolution (not amended).** The dissolution provision of the Articles of Incorporation is retained without change: "Upon dissolution, assets shall be distributed to one or more tax-exempt organizations under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code, as determined by the Board of Directors."

> Carries its authorities verbatim. Authority: Articles of Incorporation, Colorado Secretary of State document 20251193974; 26 CFR 1.501(c)(3)-1(b)(4); Instructions for Form 1023 (Rev. December 2024), Part III line 2, Dissolution clause; C.R.S. 7-122-102.

## Staged acts (not executed)

- **The Board of Directors adopts the Articles of Amendment** (executed: false). Vote: a majority of the directors in office at the time the amendment is adopted (C.R.S. 7-130-102(3)); by written action the same majority signs (Bylaws 4.12). Preconditions: The Corporation's records show that no members have been admitted to membership, so that C.R.S. 7-130-102(3) lets the Board adopt the amendment alone; if any member entitled to vote has been admitted, the amendment is adopted under C.R.S. 7-130-103 with the members' approval instead. The Articles of Incorporation require no person other than the Board to approve an amendment (C.R.S. 7-130-301). At a meeting: notice under C.R.S. 7-128-203 and Bylaws 4.9 stating that a purpose of the meeting is to consider the amendment, with a copy or summary of it. Counsel has reviewed the draft, as the Secretary of State's form advises (form AMD_NPC Section 7). Steps: Circulate policies/drafts/articles-of-amendment.md to every director with the notice. Adopt it by the vote stated, and record the adoption in the minutes (Bylaws 11.1).
- **File the Articles of Amendment with the Colorado Secretary of State** (executed: false). Preconditions: adopt-amendment executed. The individual who will cause delivery is designated by the Board (form AMD_NPC Section 6); the filing fee is the one the Secretary of State's fee schedule states on the day of filing, which this register does not pin. Steps: File form AMD_NPC online with the Colorado Secretary of State for entity 20251193974, with Sections 1 to 7 as the draft states and the attachment carrying Amendments 1 to 4. Commit the filed document's number to nonprofit/sources.json and re-run nonprofit/snapshot.mjs and nonprofit/project.mjs, so that the register reads the amendment from the Secretary of State's record.
